name: Trick or Treat
summary: A glossy Halloween candy world: hard-candy shine, gummy jelly, matte marshmallow and chocolate on a melting chocolate floor.
description: Everything in the world is edible and rendered like a premium candy ad: every shape gets a top-left radial gradient, sharp white speculars, a lower-right rim light and one soft cocoa-plum silhouette outline. Characters are hard candy, licorice, two-layer gummies, marshmallow and dark chocolate with glowing caramel cracks. The floor is a milk-chocolate bar grid with caramel pools, pink sugar-sand, mint frosting and dark cookie-crumb paths, strewn with sprinkles. Cute, saturated and sticky-sweet, but never flat vector.
avoidFor: UIs that need a calm neutral palette

difficulty.why: Making glossy material convincing costs iterations, and adding more content quickly tips over into candy chaos.

technique.resolution: Native resolution. Sprites baked once at K = clamp(round(S*1.25), 3, 6) px per world unit (S = screen px per unit, 360 units tall); ground decals at 4 px/unit; ground chunks per-pixel at up to 2.5 px/unit.
technique.summary: Each body part is a path filled with a top-left radial gradient (light, mid at 50%, dark), then layered with clipped material passes (jelly edge, rim light, stripes, ribs) and sharp white speculars; the finished sprite gets a soft cocoa outline by stamping a tinted copy 12 times around itself.
technique.linework: No internal ink lines. One outer silhouette outline in cocoa-plum #3a1424, 0.5 world units wide (0.45 ghosts in #5a3a66, 0.6 brute, 0.4 pickups, 0.18 sprinkles), produced by drawing a solid-tinted copy offset in 12 (16 if > 2.5 px) directions. Inner detail is done with colour and translucent strokes (0.35-0.7 units, round caps/joins).
technique.shading: Rendered, not cel: radial gradient centred at (cx - 0.38r, cy - 0.45r) from r*0.05 to r*1.18 with stops light / mid @0.5 / dark @1. Materials add clipped passes: hard candy = inner warm glow + ribs + rim; gummy = milky core, 0.42r saturated edge band, subsurface glow lower-right; marshmallow = soft white-to-lilac gradient without sharp specs; chocolate = dark brown gradient + peach rim light.
technique.lighting: One key light from the top-left on everything. Sharp white specular ellipses at the upper-left (alpha 0.9-0.95), a tiny dot specular above, a weak secondary reflection lower-left or lower-right (alpha 0.45-0.55). Rim light on the lower-right edge via a clipped diagonal gradient stroke. Warm caramel glow (additive) behind the hero's head and inside carved faces. Plum radial vignette on screen.
technique.texture: Material textures only: sugar crystals (0.45-unit white squares), candy stripes, licorice twist grooves, piped frosting ridges, sprinkles. Ground: per-texel hash grain on sugar-sand, Worley crumb cells on cookie paths, sine ridges on frosting, sine gloss streaks on caramel.

paletteRules: Every hue appears as a light/mid/dark triple inside one radial gradient; never fill a body with a single flat colour.
Highlights are pure white (#ffffff), shadows and outlines are the warm cocoa-plum #3a1424 / rgba(45,12,22,...) - never black or grey.
Ground stays mid-value and warm (chocolate, caramel, pastel pink and mint) so the saturated, high-contrast characters pop on top.
Sprinkles use the fixed set #ff4f8b #ffd23a #4fd6ff #7ee26a #b88cff #ff9a3a #ffffff and are the only place where all hues mix.
Glowing elements (carved faces, cracks, lanterns) use the caramel ramp #fffbd6 -> #ffe07a -> #ffa12a -> #e2650e.
Enemy variants differ by gummy hue (purple, pink, blue) while sharing the milky white bottom layer and green jelly leaves.

typography.role: HUD numbers, timer, titles, damage numbers, card names

typography.css: font: 800 12px/1 'Sniglet', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1.6px; color: #fff3e0; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(120,30,0,.8);

background.summary: A per-pixel distance-field ground: a milk-chocolate floor (34-unit bar grid that fades into glossy melted swirls) with four material layers from fBm noise - sunken caramel pools, pink strawberry sugar-sand, raised mint frosting with dripping glossy rims, and dark cookie-crumb paths - each with antialiased edges, contact shadows and rim highlights, plus baked candy decals.
layers: Milk chocolate #7e4c32: bar grid (34 units, 0.9-unit groove at -26%, +11% bevel on top/left 3.2 units, -9% on bottom/right) blended with sine gloss bands where the grid mask is off
Caramel pools (sunken): edge #ec9c3a to deep #b25a1a, dark inner lip on the upper edge, light lip rgb(255,226,160) on the lower edge, thin sine gloss streaks
Pink sugar-sand #f4acc2: +/-3.5% grain per 0.5-unit texel, 0.3% pure white sparkle grains #fff6fa, soft drop shadow 2.6 units
Mint frosting #a0dab8 (raised): piped sine ridges, white gloss line 0.9 units inside the top edge, darker edge, drop shadow 5 units, drips up to 9 units on down-facing edges every 4.2 units
Cookie-crumb paths #543226: Worley crumb cells lit from top-left, crumbly noisy edge, sunken darker border

Decals (baked into chunks, each with a soft rgba(50,15,20,.25) ellipse shadow): chocolate chips, sprinkles, candy corn, mini marshmallows, mini pumpkins on chocolate; glints, hearts, mini lollipops, gumdrops on sugar; frosting dollops on mint; crumbs on paths
Props (y-sorted with actors): lollipop trees, gumdrop bushes, candy-cane fences, wrapped-candy rocks, chocolate gravestones with frosting R.I.P., pumpkin candy buckets, cupcake houses

characters.summary: Chunky toy-like figures ~18-28 units wide built from glossy primitives (ellipses, capsules, bezier blobs). Each part gets a material treatment; the whole sprite gets one soft cocoa silhouette outline. 4 baked walk frames per character plus a flash-tinted copy and mirrored copies; motion is mostly squash, stretch, bob and rotation at draw time.
rules: Head-heavy proportions: the hero's head is a 22x18-unit hard-candy pumpkin on a 9-unit licorice body.
Every part: top-left radial gradient, then at least one white specular ellipse upper-left, then a rim light lower-right.
Faces are carved holes that glow caramel (dark #7a2406 fill, then the same shape offset (0.2, 0.55) filled with a hot radial gradient) or glossy dark ellipses with yellow and white catchlights.
Material sets the enemy type: gummy = small melee, marshmallow = fast floater (semi-transparent at the hem), dark chocolate with glowing caramel cracks = brute.
Outline 0.5 units #3a1424 around the whole silhouette only; never ink inner shapes.
Keep shapes readable at 18-30 units: few large forms, small details only as speculars and stripes.

effects.name: Seed projectile
effects.how: Glossy candy-seed sprite (gloss + 1.6x0.55 spec) flipping scaleY 0.6-1.0 with |cos(spin)|, behind it a 13-unit white gradient streak (1.6 wide) with two thin pink side streaks rgba(255,140,190,.9).

effects.name: Hit star
effects.how: 8-point rounded star (r 5.6/2.4) filled white -> #fff4fa -> #ffb3d6 with a hot-pink #ff5c9e outline, life 0.14 s, scale 0.5 -> 1.2 -> 0.3; plus a few sprinkles and an additive sugar sparkle.

effects.name: Sprinkle burst
effects.how: Capsule sprinkles (2.3x0.9 units, white top highlight line, dark bottom line, 0.18 outline) in 7 colours, thrown with vz 50-120, gravity 300, spinning; shrink in the last 20% of life.

effects.name: Candy death
effects.how: Enemy squashes up to 1.25x with a 44 Hz wobble, flashes white, gone after 0.42 s. Gummies burst into 6 gummy chunks, the brute into chocolate shards, caramel drops, candy corn, cream puffs and a striped shock ring; ghosts burst into 5 marshmallow puffs.

effects.name: Wrapper spawn
effects.how: Non-floating enemies pop out of an unwrapping candy wrapper decal (zig-zag edge, white-banded gradient, dark centre) with outElastic scale-in and confetti; the wrapper fades after 70% of spawn time.

effects.name: Sugar sparkles
effects.how: Additive ('lighter') 4-point sparkle (quadratic star) over a soft coloured radial glow, twinkling with sin(t*2.2); also drift slowly in the air in one per 140-unit cell.

effects.name: Level-up ring
effects.how: Ellipse ring (ry = 0.45 rx) expanding with outQuad, stroked cocoa (w+1.2), then white, then a dashed [2.2, 2.6] pink line; plus 22 sprinkles and 14 flipping confetti rectangles.

ui.summary: Chunky candy-shop HUD: thick #3a1424 borders with a 4-5 px solid drop below (like a pressed candy button), glossy top-half white gloss overlay on everything, peppermint-striped bars in dark chocolate troughs, an orange wrapped-candy timer badge, Chewy numbers with a 16-direction cocoa outline.

motion: Hero hop-walk: phase = anim*0.42 per hop, lift = sin(f*PI)*3.2 units, squash on contact (sx +12%, sy -13%), stretch in air (sy +7%), tilt 0.07 rad toward facing; frames 1/3 on contact, 2 in air, 0 idle.
Gummy enemies: 4 frames, jelly wobble sx = 1 + 0.07*(1-|sin|), sy = 1 - 0.08*(1-|sin|) + 0.04*|sin|, rotation 0.1*sin, bob 1.3 units.
Marshmallow floaters: hover 4.5 units up, bob 1.6 units at 2.6 rad/s, frames at 6 fps, wavy hem; alpha 0.9; tilt with velocity up to 0.14 rad.
Brute: slow 4-frame stomp, contact squash 8% with a cubic contact curve, rotation 0.035*sin.
Hit: squash sx +18%, sy -15% and a white flash overlay (max alpha 0.55; 0.45 for brutes).
Pickups bob 1.2 +/- 0.9 units at 4 rad/s with a slight 5% squash and +/-0.18 rad sway; collected pickups pop with outBack.
Spawn: outElastic scale-in from a wrapper; UI uses overshooting cubic-bezier(.3,1.7,.5,1) pops and a 0.25 s squash wobble on damage.
do: Fill every shape with the top-left radial gradient (light, mid @0.5, dark) and add a white specular ellipse at about (-0.4r, -0.45r).
Add a lower-right rim light (clipped stroke, gradient transparent until 60%) to round, glossy parts.
Choose a real candy material per object (hard candy, gummy, licorice, marshmallow, chocolate, frosting) and stay consistent with it.
Wrap each finished sprite in one soft 0.5-unit cocoa #3a1424 outline.
Make faces glow: carved caramel holes or glossy dark eyes with yellow and white catchlights.
Use sprinkles, sugar sparkles and confetti for every hit, pickup and kill.
Keep shadows warm cocoa-plum and soft (radial ellipse, 0.42 alpha centre).
dont: Do not use flat fills or hard cel bands - that turns it into generic vector cartoon.
Do not use black outlines or inner ink lines.
Do not light from different directions per object; the highlight is always top-left.
Do not use grey or blue shadows; everything warm.
Do not saturate the ground as much as the characters - the floor must stay calmer.
Do not add more than ~7 hues on screen per material group; candy chaos kills readability in large hordes.
Do not draw gradients per frame for every actor - bake sprites.
performance: All characters, props, pickups and particles are baked once into canvases at K px/unit (4 walk frames + flash tint + mirrored copies), so a frame is mostly drawImage calls plus a few additive glows. The ground is the hot spot: per-pixel distance fields over a 4-unit grid with bilinear interpolation, computed in a generator in 256-unit chunks and capped at 2.5 px/unit; decals are stamped into the chunk afterwards. Damage numbers are cached per value (max 400). The vignette is a 320 px sprite stretched over the screen.
